title: DeliveryLane
description: One project's independent delivery lane within a DeliveryOrchestration, and the schedulable unit the worker scheduler leases and advances through waiting/blocked/runnable/leased/running/review/failed/accepted. A lane always carries its own project_id so cross-project reads and writes fail closed.

parent_task_id.description: Id of the parent task this lane delivers, assigned once the dependency graph resolves it. Empty until then.

status.description: The scheduling state machine. waiting: predecessors unresolved. blocked: an unresolved hard blocker was reported with evidence. runnable: no unresolved predecessor, no worker leased yet. leased: a worker holds an unexpired lease but has not reported starting. running: the leased worker is actively executing. review: work reported complete, awaiting review. failed: rejected, expired past retry budget, or reported failed. accepted: terminal success.

lease_worker_id.description: Worker holding the current lease; empty when not leased/running.

lease_token.description: Opaque token the leaseholder must present to heartbeat/complete/reject - proves it still holds this lease, not a stale or resumed one.

lease_expires_at.description: Lease/heartbeat deadline; past this with no renewal, the lease is expired and the lane returns to runnable.

attempt.description: Number of leases granted so far for this lane; incremented on retry.

blocked_by.description: Exact blocker ids (unresolved predecessor task ids, or a reported discovered blocker) while status is waiting or blocked.

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented on every applied event.
